 Where to Watch Joseph Zada Before Sunrise on the Reaping 
 Amanda McArthur 
 Nov 3, 2026
 If The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping is set to be your introduction to Joseph Zada , prepare to discover a young Australian actor who’s built an impressive résumé at an unbelievable pace.
 In just a couple of years, he’s gone from a breakout role on an acclaimed Australian drama to a Prime Video mystery, a Netflix prestige adaptation and the lead of one of the year’s biggest movies.
 Whenever you’re ready to start diving into his career, here’s a guide to his most memorable works and where you can stream them in the U.S.
 Invisible Boys (2025)
 Joseph’s breakout role came as Charlie Roth, the troubled teen at the center of the Stan original drama Invisible Boys , based on Holden Sheppard’s novel.
 The series follows a group of gay teenagers in the coastal town of Geraldton, Western Australia, after Charlie is outed on social media following an encounter with a married man. Across the series, Joseph’s sensitive performance is the heart of the story.
 Invisible Boys is headed to Hulu in the U.S., though the premiere date hasn’t yet been announced.
 ( Invisible Boys via Stan)
 We Were Liars (2025)
 Joseph also turned heads in Prime Video’s adaptation of E. Lockhart’s bestselling novel We Were Liars as Johnny Sinclair Dennis.
 The viral mystery follows a wealthy family and the group of teens known as the Liars, putting Joseph in front of a much bigger international audience.
 We Were Liars is streaming on Prime Video.
 ( We Were Liars via Prime Video)
 Also read about: Joseph Zada and Mckenna Grace Bring The Hunger Games Fashion to Paris 
 East of Eden (2026)
 Next, Joseph stepped into prestige TV as Caleb “Cal” Trask in Netflix’s limited series adaptation of John Steinbeck’s East of Eden , opposite Florence Pugh, Christopher Abbott and Mike Faist.
 Adapted by Zoe Kazan, the seven-episode saga follows the Trask family across generations, with Joseph and Joe Anders playing twin brothers Cal and Aron.
 East of Eden is streaming on Netflix, where it premiered on Oct. 1.
 ( East of Eden via Netflix)
 The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping (2026)
 And finally, there’s the role that has Joseph stepping into Panem: a young Haymitch Abernathy, the character originally played by Woody Harrelson.
 The film follows a 16-year-old Haymitch as he’s thrown into the 50th Hunger Games, opposite Whitney Peak’s Lenore Dove Baird and Mckenna Grace ‘s Maysilee Donner. To catch up on her earlier work, read Where to Watch Mckenna Grace Before Sunrise on the Reaping .
 With three standout screen roles already behind him, Joseph looks more than ready to carry a franchise.
 The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping hits theaters on Nov. 20.
 ( The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping via Lionsgate)
